description: Say which key results one initiative moves — the one write that ties delivery work to the strategy. Any number, under any objectives and pillars. REPLACES the list: to add one, read the current list first and pass the union. Pass [] for enabling work that moves none on its own, or null to clear the answer (it then reads as orphan work). A program's key results and objectives are derived from its initiatives. Requires `write` scope and a key holder who can edit initiatives.

keyResultIds.description: The key results it moves. [] = enabling work; null = clear the answer.

name: anyforge_set_initiative_key_results
title: Set initiative key results
